one_liner: Web data infrastructure providing scraping APIs, proxies, and an official Model Context Protocol server.
auth_notes: Bright Data uses API keys / tokens generated from the user settings control panel.
access_notes: Sign up on Bright Data with a free tier offering credits or free monthly requests.
